First, note the date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 04-17-1339.  
Add 298 days:  

1339 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1339 not divisible by 4).  
Days from 04-17 to end of year:  
April: 30 - 17 = 13 days left in April.  
May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) + November (30) + December (31) = 245 days from May to Dec.  
Total days left in 1339 = 13 + 245 = 258 days.  

298 - 258 = 40 days into 1340.  
1340 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
January 1340 has 31 days, so 40 - 31 = 9 days into February.  
February 9, 1340 = 1340-02-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1340-02-09
